simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to לַהַד (H3855) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-pr-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word is connected to the original Hebrew source text, so BibleIQ can explain it from the underlying word rather than only the English translation.
simple.summary: לַהַד (Lahad) means Lahad , an Israelite First listed occurrence: 1Chr 4 2.

definitions.full: H3855. Lahad לָ֑הַד proper name, masculine son of יַ֫חַת of Judah 1Chr 4:2 , ᵐ5 Λααθ , ᵐ5 L Λααδ (etymology and meaning unknown).
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root meaning to glow (compare 3851 ) or else to be earnest (compare 3854 );
